# [I1 — Changing station network](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/hypodraft_i1.py`: what the data held here can and cannot show about the hypothesis. Each marked statement links to what it rests on.*

**Hypothesis.** [I1](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network"): stations were added, moved and dropped over the record, so a published trend can be a trend in where you looked.

**Draft, not a result.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-STATUS">The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes the June–September counts per era, the balanced panel or either trajectory, so no count of them, no band and no p-value is reported here.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-STATUS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The observable consequence, stated so it can fail

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-DESIGN">Hold the station set fixed and the season fixed, and recompute the June–September near-bed oxygen trajectory 1985–2024 in eras of [5](../SOURCES.md#F-575984c5fb) years.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-DESIGN "What this claim rests on")</sup>

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-SUPPORT">**[I1](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network") is supported** if the era-to-era change measured on the fixed set differs from the change measured on the full pooled record by more than the fixed set's own sampling band — that is, the pooled trajectory lies outside the band in at least one era.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-SUPPORT "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-FAIL">**[I1](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network") fails** if the two trajectories track each other inside the band in every era — a real possible outcome, and the interesting one: the network's turnover would then not have moved the number, and the composition objection could be set aside for this variable.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-FAIL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The data held, counted here

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-PANEL">`docs/data/areas/stations_series.{json,bin}` holds [679,422](../SOURCES.md#F-b61d7944ec) station-months at [1,415](../SOURCES.md#F-fff0060a3d) stations, in [564](../SOURCES.md#F-008df4b99b) monthly slots from January 1980, for [9](../SOURCES.md#F-81bea72caf) variables; the `.bin` is [5,435,376](../SOURCES.md#F-91ec567fa1) bytes, exactly [8](../SOURCES.md#F-5ccadf68a1) bytes per station-month, as the layout's `uint16` station index, `uint16` month index and `float32` value per point imply. The variable used, `oxy_bed`, is held on [76,980](../SOURCES.md#F-a95c664ddf) station-months at [1,327](../SOURCES.md#F-a053d110be) stations.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-PANEL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-BALRULE">**Balanced panel:** the stations with a June–September `oxy_bed` value in *every* era. Its size, and the share of June–September values outside it, have not been computed here.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-BALRULE "What this claim rests on")</sup>

**What the values carry.**

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-AGG">*Aggregation.* Each value is already a median per station, month and depth layer, over every value in that layer of every cast that month; how many casts went into it is not stored, so [I3](../hypodrafts/I3.md "Changing sampling frequency and season")'s effort confound cannot be controlled inside this file: a station visited once and one visited often weigh the same.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-AGG "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-EVENMED">*Resolution.* Where a station-month holds an even number of values, its median is the mean of the two middle values, so a stored value can sit between the steps the raw values were reported in.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-EVENMED "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-CLOCK">*Hour.* The CTD extract the panel is built from has no time of day in any row and no column for it, so the diel oxygen swing aliases into whichever hour the boat went, per station. The water-chemistry extract does carry clock values, which can bound the hour only where a cast shares its day with a bottle.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-CLOCK "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-REGISTER">**The station register cannot supply station lifespans.** `data/raw/oda/stations.csv` holds [798,574](../SOURCES.md#F-9799555964) rows and [6,288](../SOURCES.md#F-1acb8bcb68) distinct `ObservationsstedNr`, and carries only [34](../SOURCES.md#F-9fee8eb468) of the [1,415](../SOURCES.md#F-a65709e687) series stations. `StartDato` equals `SlutDato` on [796,990](../SOURCES.md#F-e7acc135b6) of the [798,574](../SOURCES.md#F-e46c5b924b) rows with both dates ([99.8](../SOURCES.md#F-3dbeb389fb)%): the field holds a visit date, not a station lifespan — a column named as a validity period carrying an event date.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-REGISTER "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-PRESENCE">So the start and end dates [I1](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network") needs are not held; presence must be derived from the observation record itself, era by era.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-PRESENCE "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The null, under the constraint actually imposed

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-NULLCONSTR">The constraint is *a fixed station set × a fixed season window*, which shrinks n and clusters it into as many groups as the panel has stations. The relevant null is therefore **not** the sampling distribution of a median over independent draws, and no published standard error applies.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-NULLCONSTR "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-BOOT">**Primary null.** `H0`: the pooled trajectory is what the fixed network would have shown. Cluster bootstrap over the panel's stations — draw as many stations as the panel holds, *with replacement*, carrying each station's entire era-by-era June–September value set, and recompute Δ_fixed(e) = med(e) − med(first era). [5,000](../SOURCES.md#F-2c37f19a90) replicates give a percentile band per era; reject `H0` where Δ_pooled(e) falls outside the [95](../SOURCES.md#F-9a62a06c3d)% band.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-BOOT "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-UNIT">The station is the resampling unit because observations are not independent within it; resampling observations would understate the band, by up to a factor of √(observations per station) when a station's observations move together.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-UNIT "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-SECONDARY">**Secondary null, for the season channel.** Month-stratified station-label permutation: within each (era, calendar-month) cell, permute station labels among observations. Era n, month composition and every visit schedule stay fixed; only the association between *which* station and *what value* is destroyed. It will almost certainly reject — stations differ in depth and level by construction — so it is a check on the season channel, not a test of [I1](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network"). Do not present rejection here as support.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-SECONDARY "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-MULT">**Multiplicity.** Pre-register the contrast between the last era and the first as primary; treat the intermediate eras as descriptive, Holm-corrected.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-MULT "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Procedure

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-P1">Read `stations_series.bin` at the `oxy_bed` offset the `.json` gives; decode the `uint16` station index, the `uint16` month index and the `float32` value; `year = 1980 + month//12`, calendar month = `month%12 + 1`.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-P1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-P2">Keep June–September, 1985–2024. Assign eras.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-P2 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-P3">Balanced panel = the intersection of the per-era station sets.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-P3 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
4. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-P4">Compute Δ_pooled(e) and Δ_fixed(e).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-P4 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
5. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-P5">Run both nulls above.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-P5 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
6. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-P6">Repeat for `oxysat_bed`, `sal_bed` and `temp_bed`. Salinity and oxygen saturation are computed (from conductivity and temperature, and from oxygen, temperature and salinity), so these are not independent replications: a consistent result across them is one result, not several.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-P6 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-NOLABEL">No script in this repository defines a split of the stations by the season they are sampled in, so no such label enters this design.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-NOLABEL "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-CIRC">**On the classification circularity.** A label that sorts stations by the season of their sampling, made on each station's *whole* record, labels a station that switched regime by its aggregate — contaminated by the very time-variation under test. This design avoids the problem rather than fixing it: the balanced panel is defined by **presence**, observable per era, and no behavioural label enters the primary test. Any secondary analysis wanting such a label must assign it **within era**, and report the switch rate before using a pooled label.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-CIRC "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What a result would and would not license

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-WOULD">**Would license.** Whether, at the positions watched in every era, the June–September near-bed oxygen change is the change the pooled record reports — and if not, a quantified size for the composition contribution.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-WOULD "What this claim rests on")</sup>

**Would not license.**

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-NOTWB">Any statement about a water body. The panel's stations are wherever they happen to be; they are not a designed sample of anything, and aggregating them into Vandområder would import the model assumption this repository refuses.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-NOTWB "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-NOTTRUE">A claim that the fixed-panel trajectory is the *true* trend. The panel is survivorship-selected: stations present in every era may differ from the ones that came and went, in depth, programme or place. Holding the network fixed trades a composition bias for a selection bias; it does not remove bias. The honest reading of agreement is “turnover did not move this number”, not “this is what the sea did”.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-NOTTRUE "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-NOTCAUSE">Anything about oxygen *causes*. Composition is an instrument question.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-NOTCAUSE "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-GI-I1-NOTTRANSFER">Transfer to other variables, other seasons, or the years before 1985, which the design leaves out.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-GI-I1-NOTTRANSFER "What this claim rests on")</sup>
